runtime_guard: six heads, derived FP16 cache, selected keys, SVE16 lanes and at least512 keys
case_scope: Only mode3 with six heads invokes the integrated helper; all other cases are diagnostic variants or the legacy reference.

modes.3: normalize once, then two heads x32 columns
modes.4: normalize once, then three heads x64 columns

arithmetic: Same volatile per-key division result, ascending-key SVE FMA chain and half-cache conversion as legacy value64_f16; modes3/4 include a parallel normalizer and its barrier
input: Varied signs/mantissas/exponents106..137 and per-rank seeds; nonnegative probabilities including zeros/FP32 subnormals and nontrivial divisors
finite_guards: IEEE exponent checks and entire strided output/canary memcmp; out-of-place and in-place normalization including inactive rows/tails and canaries
measurement: 12-rank maximum,100 calls inside one team, varying2052..2006 counts; seven rotating mode sweeps

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
root=$HOME/work/gemm/glm53f-strata-20261001
cd "$root/a64fx/glm5"
work=$root/tmp/strata-mla-logits-20261003
old=$root/tmp/strata-pipeline-20261002/build
base=$root/tmp/strata-mhc-sync-20261002/build-integrated-login-v4
bin=$PWD/build/candidate-mla-values-model-v1
[ ! -e "$bin" ]
mkdir -p "$bin"
export TMPDIR=$work OPAL_PREFIX=/opt/FJSVxtclanga/tcsds-1.2.43
unset OMPI_CC OMPI_CXX
cc=/opt/FJSVxtclanga/tcsds-1.2.43/bin/mpifccpx
flags=(-Nclang -O3 -march=armv8.2-a+sve -ffp-contract=fast -fopenmp -Wall -Wextra -Werror -ffast-math -fno-math-errno -DGLM53F_PREFILL_ATTN_PANEL=47 -DGLM53F_PREFILL_CAPACITY=4096 -I. -I../../common)
"$cc" "${flags[@]}" test_glm53f_mla_values_team.c -lm -o "$bin/test_glm53f_mla_values_team"

"$cc" "${flags[@]}" -DGLM53F_EXTERNAL_ST_IMPLEMENTATION -DGLM53F_SPARSE_NO_MAIN -c glm53f_sparse_layer_12n.c -o "$work/sparse_values_v1.o"
objects=("$base"/{q8_panel,gemm_kern,gemm_asm,team,collective}.o "$root/tmp/strata-iq-scales-20261002/build-integrated-v5/iq_bridge.o" "$old/kda_pp_beta_rowwise.o" "$root/tmp/strata-pipeline-20261003/dense_tiles_full.o" "$old/moe_pp_fast.o" "$work/sparse_values_v1.o" "$root/tmp/strata-mtp-batch-20261003/head_verify.o" "$root/tmp/strata-mtp-batch-20261003/embedding_prime.o" "$old"/{dist,pipeline}_pp.o)

"$cc" "${flags[@]}" bench_glm53f_run_12n.c "$base"/{lookup_spec,mtp_spec}.o "$root/tmp/strata-mtp-batch-20261003/mtp_prime.o" "${objects[@]}" "$root/tmp/strata-pipeline-20261003/target_dense_tiles.o" "${link[@]}" -o "$bin/bench_glm53f_run_12n"

sha256sum "$bin"/{test_glm53f_mla_values_team,bench_glm53f_run_12n} > "$work/binaries-values-model-v1.sha256"

driver_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/work/gemm/glm53f-strata-20261001"
logs=$PWD/tmp/strata-mla-logits-20261003
[ "${PJM_JOBID:-}" = 52138572 ] && [ "$PJM_NODE" = 12 ]
guard=$(date -d '2026-10-04 04:45:00 JST' +%s)
grep -q '^MLA_LOGITS_FULL_PASS$' "$logs/driver-full-v3.log" || exit 2
grep -q '^MLA_VALUES_PRESCALE_NATIVE_PASS$' "$logs/driver-values-prescale-v2.log" || exit 2
grep -q '^MLA_VALUES_MODEL_BUILD_PASS$' "$logs/build-values-model-v1.log" || exit 2
[ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$((guard-600))" ] || exit 75
if pgrep -f '[m]piexec|[p]lexec|[p]lspawn' > /dev/null; then
 echo 'REFUSE concurrent MPI at integrated values launch' >&2; exit 2
fi
export GLM53F_BUILD=0 GLM53F_GGUF=$HOME/models/glm53f-gguf-wide/UD-Q4_K_XL/GLM-5.3-Flash-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00006.gguf
export GLM53F_BIN_DIR=$PWD/a64fx/glm5/build/candidate-mla-values-model-v1 GLM53F_RUN_TAG=mtp-batch3-gates
export XOS_MMM_L_PAGING_POLICY=demand:demand:demand XOS_MMM_L_HPAGE_TYPE=none
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=47 OMP_PROC_BIND=close OMP_PLACES=cores OMP_WAIT_POLICY=active FLIB_BARRIER=HARD
export GLM53F_PREWARM=1 GLM53F_PROFILE=1 GLM53F_FAST_MATH=1 GLM53F_NO_MATH_ERRNO=1
export GLM53F_COMM_OWNER=0 GLM53F_SPARSE_ASYNC=0 GLM53F_NATIVE_Q8_PANEL=0 GLM53F_SPARSE_MLA_BATCH=1
export GLM53F_NATIVE_Q8_ROWS8=0 GLM53F_NATIVE_Q8_TILE2X8=0 GLM53F_MLA_FUSED_PROJECTION=0 GLM53F_MHC_FUSED_SYNC=0 GLM53F_MOE_GU_PAD=0
export GLM53F_EMBED_BATCH_PACKED=0 GLM53F_HEAD_VERIFY_SHARED=0 GLM53F_DENSE_PREFILL_TILE=4
fail(){ echo "error: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
source a64fx/glm5/scripts/glm53f_env.sh
source a64fx/glm5/scripts/glm53f_launch.sh
mkdir -p "$logdir" "$GLM53F_BUILD_DIR" "$logs/results"
# This synthetic MPI fixture has no model staging or tofu dependency.
for math in fast conservative; do
 binary="$GLM53F_BIN_DIR/test_glm53f_mla_values_team"
 [ "$math" = fast ] || binary="$binary-conservative"
 for threads in 1 47; do
  OMP_NUM_THREADS=$threads mpi_run "mla-values-integrated-$math-$threads" /usr/bin/numactl --interleave=4,5,6,7 "$binary"
  grep '^MLA_VALUES_TEAM cases=1620 .*BIT_EXACT PASS$' "$last_log".*.0
  cp "$last_log".*.0 "$logs/results/values-integrated-$math-$threads.log"
 done
done
echo MLA_VALUES_INTEGRATED_NATIVE_PASS
python3 "$logs/gate-values-integrated.py"
mkdir -p "$logs/results-values-model"
prepare_runtime
python3 "$logs/campaign-values-model-v1.py"
echo MLA_VALUES_MODEL_FULL_PASS
